sentences: How often do you go to the gym?
I work out regularly, three times a week.

He stretches slowly before every workout.
I try to eat healthily and exercise daily.
Push yourself gradually to avoid soreness.

grammar.title: Talking About Fitness — Adverbs of Manner + How Often
rules: Advérbios de modo (geralmente -ly) descrevem como a ação é feita: carefully, slowly, regularly.
"How often" pergunta sobre frequência: How often do you work out?
Advérbios de frequência (always, usually, regularly) geralmente vêm antes do verbo principal.
Advérbios de modo geralmente vêm depois do verbo ou objeto: She lifts weights carefully.
